Planned "欠落指摘 finding の構造化宣言と finding-ref 反転検証" — wrote design.md (202 lines), spec.md (70), tasks.md (160) under specrunner/changes/missing-file-finding-declaration/.

Design summary:
- D1: add optional `fileMissing?: boolean` to `Finding` (src/kernel/report-result.ts) + capture in `parseFindings` (src/core/port/report-result.ts), additive/backward-compatible like `origin`.
- D2: add `fileMissing: optional(boolean())` to `findingSchema` (JUDGE/CODE_REVIEW/REQUEST_REVIEW) and `conformanceFindingSchema`, plus 4 tool descriptions — contract injected via schema, not prompt body.
- D3: split affectingFindings at the caller (step-completion.ts:238-256) into missing-declared vs non-declared and invert the expectation. Non-declared: nonexistent→escalation override (unchanged). Missing-declared: existing file (= not in nonexistent subset)→escalation override; truly absent→no override, routing-bearing verdict preserved. verifyFindingRefs seam semantics/signature untouched (two group-scoped calls).
- D4: strip `line` for missing-declared refs. D5: escalationReason suppression unchanged (both override paths set verdictOverriddenByFindingRef). D6: runtime symmetry proven by driving deriveStepCompletion through real LocalRuntime + ManagedRuntime.
- Tasks T-01..T-06 map 1:1 to the acceptance criteria (scenario tooth #916, false declaration, regression protection with escalationReason=undefined, local/managed symmetry, existing tests unchanged, typecheck && test green).

NOTE for the operator/implementer — a factual discrepancy vs request.md: the request and the request-review attestation both state "local verifyFindingRefs has no unit test", but tests/unit/core/runtime/verify-finding-refs.test.ts (TC-VFR-L-001..007) already covers the local seam directly. It does not change the approach (the seam is not modified; the new tests pin the call-site reversal via both runtimes), and design.md documents this correction explicitly. All my out-of-attestation assertions (custom-reviewer.ts:115 / regression-gate.ts:94 use JUDGE_REPORT_TOOL; findingSchema/conformanceFindingSchema locations; boolean already imported) were verified against the code.
